FILLING OF A VACANCY UNDER PARAGRAPH 13 (b) OF ARTICLE 99 OF THE CONSTITUTION
OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA

WHEREAS the Secretary - General of Parliament has informed me, under Section 64(1) of the Parliamentary Elections Act,No. 1 of 1981, as amended by Act, No. 15 of 1988, that a vacancy has occurred in the membership of the Seventh Parliamentby reason of death of Mr. Neranjan Wickramasinghe, who was declared elected as a Member of Parliament for the ElectoralDistrict No. 15 - Kurunegala under Section 62 of the aforesaid Act.

And whereas the Returning Officer, for the electoral district which returned the said member was directed by meunder Section 64(1) of the aforesaid Act to fill this vacancy as provided for under paragraph 13(b) of Article 99 of theConstitution ;

And whereas the said Returning Officer acting under Section 64(2) of the aforesaid Act has made a return in Form“M” set out in the First Schedule to the aforesaid Act, to the effect that Mr. R. D. Wimaladasa was declared elected as aMember of Parliament for the said electoral district ;

Now therefore I, Mahinda Deshapriya, Commissioner of Elections, in the exercise of the powers vested in me bySection 64(2) of the aforesaid Act, do hereby notify the general public that Mr. R. D. Wimaladasa has been declared electedas a member of the Seventh Parliament for the Electoral District No. 15 - Kurunegala to fill the vacancy caused by reason ofdeath of Mr. Neranjan Wickramasinghe.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,Commissioner of Elections.Elections Secretariat,Sarana Mawatha,Rajagiriya.18th May, 2015.
